CS5 completeness is marked BLOCKED across all known-mechanizable routes (explicitly NOT incompleteness -- CS5 == IS5 is complete and sound, report 05). No sorry, no new axiom anywhere in Cslib/; lake build/checkInitImports/lint-style/shake clean; grep-confirmed no negation-completeness move (only one bare not in the new section, the obstruction theorem's own statement).
